title: The great architecture shift to AI
oneliner: Every architecture discipline is being re-prefixed with AI: solution to AI-solution, enterprise to enterprise-AI, cloud to cloud-AI. Ride the shift, don't resist it.
says: Architecture is shifting from legacy to AI-based across every discipline: solution architecture is becoming AI solution architecture, enterprise architecture is becoming enterprise AI architecture, and cloud architecture is becoming cloud AI architecture.
explained: This short reel is the thesis statement of the whole channel. The claim is not that architecture is being replaced - the -ilities, governance, and integration judgment all still apply. It is that every existing architecture role now has an AI workload to account for, and the architects who absorb that early own the transition.

The practical reading: you do not need a new identity, you need an expanded one. His Season 1 series is built exactly on this observation - it takes a classic solution architect and layers AI infrastructure on top, rather than starting over. If you are mid-career in any architecture flavor, this reel is the 'why now' behind everything else he teaches.
takeaway: The shift is additive: keep your architecture fundamentals, layer AI workload expertise on top. That combination is what the market is repricing.
